The dataset description says it collates records from published studies. These entries mirror that study; they are not independent sampling or voucher evidence.

sharedPoint.institutionCodeOrCatalogNumber: No collection institution or catalog number was supplied in the six returned occurrence records.
sharedPoint.decision: Do not accept as a site pin. A single repeated watershed point does not resolve the primary paper's malformed site-coordinate strings or identify a sampling station.

interpretation.otherBegaLocalityRecords: Exact Bega Falls and Enchanted Falls queries returned only insects and mammals, respectively; no fish records. Tiger Falls and Malipaga text searches returned zero in GBIF. The complete Prosperidad locality query returned only insect and plant classes.
interpretation.note: The matched GBIF fish rows do not add independent evidence because their associated citation points to the same 2015 survey. Search zeroes and off-target text matches are limited to the queried record index and fields.

limitations: GBIF and iDigBio locality text is a discovery method, not an exhaustive survey; spelling variants, coordinates without matching locality text, unindexed collections and specimens not digitized online may be missed.

The six GBIF fish material citations repeat the same 2015 paper and do not expose voucher institution/catalog identifiers; they cannot independently validate specimen identity or species-level resolution of the two genus labels.
All six GBIF fish rows reuse one coordinate, while the source paper's printed site coordinates remain malformed; neither source supplies a validated station geometry here.
The GBIF dataset CC BY-NC 4.0 metadata is separate from the underlying article's declared CC BY 4.0 terms; no legal/publication review authorizes app reuse of copied GBIF records or source text.
The iDigBio index is frozen after 2026-05-08 and cannot serve as a current collection census.
No search result or zero result is a fish-absence finding.
nextAction: Continue Caraga freshwater evidence work with a separate primary source that resolves fish names to named lakes/rivers and identifiable capture or voucher evidence. In parallel, seek author or MSU-Naawan clarification on Bega sample accessions and corrected station coordinates; do not infer these from the GBIF mirror or unrelated insect/mammal records.
